system.description: Spend five Willpower Traits and win a Mental Challenge resisted by the victim's Physical Traits to entrap her in an inescapable prison of pure shadow. She is held in a frigid, unlit, suffocating sphere; mortals suffocate in minutes equal to their Physical Traits, while Cainites lose access to any Discipline power below Ascendant/Methuselah level but gain two bonus Mental Challenge Traits from the isolation. Only one Oubliette may be summoned at a time.
system.duration: Until released or touched by sunlight
